classification.difficultyReason: Mastery: students must combine the two doubling relationships into football:netball:rugby = 4:2:1, recognise that these categories share the remaining 70%, and match the resulting percentages to the unkeyed sectors. This requires reframing linked verbal conditions within the taught whole-percentage model rather than directly applying a supplied share.

inlines.text: The pie chart shows the favourite sports of a group of people. The key is missing.
Twice as many people chose football as chose netball.
Twice as many people chose netball as chose rugby.
of the people surveyed chose other.
What proportion of the people surveyed is represented by each sector on the pie chart? Give each answer as a percentage.

spec.description: Four unlabelled sectors, clockwise from the upward radius: orange, blue, green, red. The title is centred above the circle; the key remains missing.
spec.mathematics: Clockwise sector angles 144, 72, 36 and 108 degrees follow the textual relationships and approved reviewed-interpretations-p38. No numerical sector values are printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the title, boundaries and distinguishing category fills are student-visible. Category names and percentages remain in the answer.

answer.short:
Football: $40\%$; netball: $20\%$; rugby: $10\%$; other: $30\%$.

Split the remaining $70\%$ in the ratio football:netball:rugby $=4:2:1$.
answer.worked:
Take rugby as one share. Netball has two shares and football has four shares.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage for these sports}&=100\%-30\%\\\text{Percentage for these sports}&=70\%\\\text{Number of shares}&=1+2+4\\\text{Number of shares}&=7\\\text{Rugby percentage}&=70\%\div7\\\text{Rugby percentage}&=10\%\\\text{Netball percentage}&=2\times10\%\\\text{Netball percentage}&=20\%\\\text{Football percentage}&=4\times10\%\\\text{Football percentage}&=40\%\end{align*}$$
Clockwise from the top: orange is football, blue is netball, green is rugby and red is other.
